description: What is on an address’s calendar between `after` and `before` (ISO 8601 date-times), in start order, with each date of a recurring event listed on its own. A meeting that started before `after` and is still running is included unless you pass `include_overlapping: "false"`. Cancelled events are left out. Use this to answer “am I free”, and before proposing a time.
name: get_agenda
title: What is on, between two moments
